message.content:
This magazine cover features a red vertical bar on the left edge. At the top, the white serif word "TEMPO" dominates. Above it, black text reads "GELIAT BARU INDUSTRI EMAS" and "KISAH PASUKAN DAYAK PENJAGA HUTAN," separated by a diagonal line. Below "TEMPO" is "ENAK DIBACA DAN PERLU."

The central headline reads "DUA WAJAH OMNIBUS" in large, black, sans-serif font. Beneath it, three lines of smaller black text describe government actions regarding the "Undang Undang Cipta Kerja."

The background shows a cloudy sky above a long, white, rectangular building with vertical rectangular windows and arched doors. An orange flag flies atop the building. Below the building, a dark, horizontal band contains numerous small, dark silhouettes of people in various poses, some appearing to run. Below this band is a large, grainy, textured area transitioning from dark grey to deep purple. A dark, shadowy reflection of the building and its flag appears inverted within this textured area.

At the bottom left, there is a QR code and a barcode with numbers including "9 770126 427302." Small text nearby reads "12-18 OKTOBER 2020," "RP 45.000," and other publishing details.
